def test_unsqueeze_view(self, device):
        t = torch.ones(5, 5, device=device)
        v = torch.unsqueeze(t, 1)
        self.assertTrue(self.is_view_of(t, v))

        v[0, 0, 1] = 0
        self.assertEqual(t[0, 1], v[0, 0, 1])
